Hi all — technical detail below, keeping it high-level for auditors and operational for Grace/Sam.

1) Retention and export windows
- Hosted (default): operational search index retained for 90 days. Full ingest shard snapshots are retained for up to 3 years for export purposes.
- Dedicated / Private: retention is configurable per contract; many customers keep 1–7 years depending on policy.

2) Export formats and granularity
- Available formats: gzipped JSONL (line-delimited events), CSV (flattened event rows), and standard RFC5424 syslog streams.
- Granularity: we can export either full event payloads (includes request metadata; note: request/response body captures must be scoped) or event-level metadata (timestamp, principal id hashed, event type, resource id, request_id).

3) Delivery modes and encryption
- S3 push: preferred for large exports. We support server-side encryption with Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed keys (BYOK/KMS) in Private and Dedicated.
- Signed HTTPS bundle: smaller exports via pre-signed URL.
- For Private deployments we can set up direct on-premise SFTP in lieu of S3.

4) Integrity and proof
- Every export bundle includes a manifest.json with file checksums (SHA256) and a signed statement (pdf) endorsing the export window and scope. We can provide a signed PDF, and for legal holds we can also provide a notarized chain-of-custody (PDF).

5) Deletion semantics
- Deletion request: we remove index records and zero out non-replicated keys; exported snapshots are treated as separate artifacts (we will redact/expire exports on request if they are still hosted by Redwood). For Dedicated/Private, exports pushed to customer infrastructure are under customer control and Redwood cannot delete those.

6) Lead times and throttling
- Typical turnaround for a 90–180 day export: 24–72 hours.
- For multi-year full-tenant exports (multi-TB) we schedule a job and provide ETA; these can take several days and may be billed as an out-of-band data transfer.

Attachments (stubs): access_trace_sample.csv (sanitized row sample), access_log_schema_v1.pdf (field definitions).

If you want, I can attach a 10-line JSONL sample to the HubSpot deal record; Grace, I'll hand off next steps to you for the MAP.

-Rishi
